Exemption ambiguity.gloss: The policy claims the data is anonymised, kept on device, or otherwise falls under a Google disclosure exemption, so whether a declaration was required is a matter of interpretation.
Exemption ambiguity.regex: exception|exempt|not collect(?:ed)? by us|on (?:your|the) device|retained on|anonym|aggregat|de-?identif
example_rationales: they do not specify the data collection process, we cannot detect whether the privacy policy's description is one of our exceptions or not.

Missing data type.gloss: A specific data type or practice named in one artefact is absent from the other.
Missing data type.regex: not mention|no mention|does ?n[o']t mention|missing|not list|not includ|not refer|not state|not specif|not declar

Data Safety does not mention anything

Empty or absent declaration.gloss: One artefact supplies no relevant content at all.
Empty or absent declaration.regex: (?:do|does|did)(?:es)? ?n[o']t provide|no info|nothing|empty|blank|not provided|no data safety|without any
